answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by requiring every identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed on proven fraud, with the record kept in a shared atlas of reputations. A lone sparrow identity with no history cannot borrow trust; it must earn it slowly through small verified jobs. Timber for the system is the audit trail: every transaction is logged and cross-checked, so spawning thousands of fake agents costs real money and time yet yields no reputation, making mass fakery unprofitable.
